resources.string: Check cacao pods in the field
Take a photo of a pod. The app marks each pod as healthy, early stage or infected.
Everything runs on your phone. Your photos never leave the device.
A screening aid, not a diagnosis
The app can miss early signs. Always check doubtful pods by eye.
